sub_agent_reviews.summary: One merged Scout searched llm-agent, llm-post-training and ai-safety, returned a unified current-week table, and recommended OSReward as a primary deep-read target.

Main agent read arXiv metadata, arXiv HTML full text and the OSReward project page, extracting benchmark construction, judge protocol, leniency analysis, OS-Shepherd data pipeline, SFT/GRPO recipe, Table 4 results and cost bounds.

Article separates OSReward human-gold evidence from held-out verifier agreement, notes the work-in-progress status, avoids overclaiming OS-Shepherd as a frontier replacement, and records that no external images were used.
